description: Fetch one invoice by id — line items, totals, balance, dates, status and invitations. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/invoices/{id}.

description.name: invoiceninja_list_quotes
description.description: List quotes (estimates), filterable by client and quote status. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/quotes.

description.name: invoiceninja_get_quote
description.description: Fetch one quote by id — line items, totals, status and the invoice it was converted to (invoice_id), if any. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/quotes/{id}.

description.name: invoiceninja_list_products
description.description: List products / services in the catalog with price, cost and default taxes. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/products.

description.name: invoiceninja_list_payments
description.description: List payments received, with amount, date, refunded/applied totals and the invoices each was applied to (paymentables). Read-only: this server never records or refunds payments. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/payments.

description.name: invoiceninja_list_expenses
description.description: List expenses, filterable by client and invoicing/payment state. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/expenses.

description.name: invoiceninja_list_vendors
description.description: List vendors (suppliers) with contacts and address. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/vendors.

description.name: invoiceninja_list_tasks
description.description: List tasks / time entries with their time_log, duration, rate and linked client, project and invoice. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/tasks.

description.name: invoiceninja_list_projects
description.description: List projects with client, budgeted hours, task rate, current hours and due date. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/projects.

description.name: invoiceninja_list_recurring_invoices
description.description: List recurring invoice schedules with frequency, next send date and remaining cycles. Read-only. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/recurring_invoices.

description.name: invoiceninja_create_client
description.description: Create a client, optionally with contacts. Give at least a name or one contact. Invoice Ninja: POST /api/v1/clients.

description.name: invoiceninja_update_client
description.description: Update a client's details; only the fields you pass change. Passing contacts replaces the contact list. Invoice Ninja: PUT /api/v1/clients/{id}.

description.name: invoiceninja_create_invoice
description.description: Create a DRAFT invoice for a client. It is not sent or emailed — use invoiceninja_mark_invoice_sent or invoiceninja_email_invoice afterwards. Invoice Ninja: POST /api/v1/invoices.

description.name: invoiceninja_update_invoice
description.description: Edit an invoice; only the fields you pass change, but line_items (if passed) replace every existing line. Does not send anything. Invoice Ninja: PUT /api/v1/invoices/{id}.

description.name: invoiceninja_mark_invoice_sent
description.description: Mark a draft invoice as sent WITHOUT emailing it. This moves it out of draft and adds its amount to the client's balance. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/invoices/{id}/mark_sent.

description.name: invoiceninja_email_invoice
description.description: OUTWARD-FACING: sends a real email with the invoice to the client's invited contacts, and marks the invoice sent. Cannot be unsent — confirm with the user first. Invoice Ninja: POST /api/v1/invoices/bulk with action=email.

description.name: invoiceninja_create_quote
description.description: Create a DRAFT quote (estimate) for a client. Nothing is emailed. Invoice Ninja: POST /api/v1/quotes.

description.name: invoiceninja_convert_quote_to_invoice
description.description: Convert a quote into a new invoice (the quote is marked converted and links to it). Returns the new invoice. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/quotes/{id}/convert_to_invoice.

description.name: invoiceninja_create_expense
description.description: Log an expense, optionally tied to a vendor, client or project and flagged to be re-invoiced. Invoice Ninja: POST /api/v1/expenses.

description.name: invoiceninja_create_task
description.description: Create a task, optionally with logged time entries, for a client or project. Invoice Ninja: POST /api/v1/tasks.

description.name: invoiceninja_create_project
description.description: Create a project for a client, with an optional hourly task rate, budget and due date. Invoice Ninja: POST /api/v1/projects.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: invoiceninja_list_clients · Private data: invoiceninja_list_clients, invoiceninja_get_client, invoiceninja_list_payments, invoiceninja_list_vendors, invoiceninja_create_client, invoiceninja_update_client, invoiceninja_email_invoice · Public sink: invoiceninja_list_clients, invoiceninja_list_recurring_invoices, invoiceninja_create_client, invoiceninja_create_invoice, invoiceninja_update_invoice, invoiceninja_email_invoice, invoiceninja_create_quote, invoiceninja_create_expense, invoiceninja_create_task, invoiceninja_create_project.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: invoiceninja_list_clients · Private data: invoiceninja_list_clients, invoiceninja_get_client, invoiceninja_list_payments, invoiceninja_list_vendors, invoiceninja_create_client, invoiceninja_update_client, invoiceninja_email_invoice · Public sink: invoiceninja_list_clients, invoiceninja_list_recurring_invoices, invoiceninja_create_client, invoiceninja_create_invoice, invoiceninja_update_invoice, invoiceninja_email_invoice, invoiceninja_create_quote, invoiceninja_create_expense, invoiceninja_create_task, invoiceninja_create_project

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
